Usage:  circleci preflight cleanup [flags]

Flags:
  -n, --dry-run           show what would be deleted without deleting
  -h, --help              help for cleanup
      --id string         only clean up the preflight with this ID
      --include-running   also delete branches whose run has not ended
      --json              Output as JSON
      --project string    project slug (e.g. gh/org/repo); defaults to git remote
      --remote string     git remote to delete branches from (default "origin")
